label: Emoji
depicts: Smiling face with two round eyes above one curved mouth
use_when: Use when the interface wants a simple happy face with two open round eyes.
avoid_when: Do not use for the winking face when one eye should close and the mouth should open.

label: Emoji
depicts: Winking face with one vertical eye above an open mouth and one angled wink
use_when: Use when the interface wants a playful wink with one open mouth instead of a closed smile.
avoid_when: Do not use for the simple smiling face when both eyes should stay round and open.

label: Visible
depicts: Eye outline with one crescent moon pupil centered inside
use_when: Use when the interface wants an eye outline with a crescent center rather than a plain round pupil.
avoid_when: Do not use for the round pupil eye when the center should look like a complete dot.

label: Visible
depicts: Eye outline with one round pupil centered around one inner dot
use_when: Use when the interface wants a standard eye outline with a round pupil in the middle.
avoid_when: Do not use for the crescent eye when the center should suggest a moon shaped pupil.

label: Factory
depicts: Factory silhouette with two cooling towers above a flat ground line
use_when: Use when the interface wants two tall cooling tower shapes instead of a boxy factory building.
avoid_when: Do not use for the zigzag roof factory when windows and one chimney should show.
